purpose: Combined Lab ranking of every board that is NOT Web REJECT (G2). Human KEEP and REFERENCE tiers listed separately. Board keys are bead+geometry only.
protocol: D1/D2/D3 · seeds 101/202/303 · N=30/seed (8-bead 5×5 N=100) · move-cap 120 · primary depth D2

referenceAnchor.note: Calibration only — not a product candidate. D2 is 98.9% move-cap draws.

humanKeep.label: 6-bead 3×5
humanKeep.why: Highest D2 elimination among KEEP boards; lowest move-cap stall.

humanKeep.why: Near-even D2 FPA; solid elimination vs 10/7.
